channel.title: Simple Product Picks - Power Banks UK
channel.description: Buying guides for power banks and portable chargers. Every link verified against the live Amazon listing.

item.title: Best Power Bank For iPhone 15 2026
item.description: Power banks sized for an iPhone 15, from a pocket top-up with a built-in cable to a Qi2 magnetic pack. Three picks compared on capacity and charge speed.

item.title: Best Power Bank For Long Flights 2026
item.description: Power banks that survive a long-haul flight, with the watt-hour figure to check before you fly. Three picks compared on real capacity, not headline numbers.

item.title: Best Budget Power Bank 2026
item.description: Which corners get cut in the budget bracket. Three 10000mAh power banks compared on charging wattage, ports and what you give up to keep the cost down.

item.title: Best Power Bank 20000mAh 2026
item.description: 20000mAh is the travel sweet spot: several phone top-ups in a pack you can carry all day. Three picks compared on output wattage, ports and carrying size.

item.title: Best Power Bank With USB C Output 2026
item.description: Charging a phone, a tablet or a laptop over USB-C asks different things of a bank. Three picks weighed on real output wattage, cables and capacity.

item.title: Best MagSafe Power Bank 2026
item.description: Plenty of MagSafe-compatible banks stop short of the full 15W. Three Qi2 magnetic power banks, compared on wireless wattage, capacity and bulk.

item.title: Best Power Bank For Laptops 2026
item.description: The best power banks for charging a laptop, from a 100W budget pick to a 250W flagship. Three picks compared on real charging wattage, not headline mAh.

item.title: Best Power Bank For Steam Deck 2026
item.description: The best power banks for a Steam Deck, chosen for 45W-plus sustained charging, real gaming hours and a cable that stays clear of the grips.

item.title: Charging A Laptop From A Power Bank
item.description: Yes, if the bank speaks USB-C Power Delivery at your laptop's wattage. What to check on the label, why a phone bank stalls a laptop, and which class of bank works.

item.title: Power Bank Rules For UK Flights
item.description: What the UK CAA allows: up to 100Wh in the cabin without asking, 100-160Wh only with airline approval, never in the hold. Plus how to read the Wh on your bank.
